measure.skull: chin to top of head, not counting hair

eyeValue: {range} from the bottom of the photo
glassesYes: Allowed in some cases (no glare or tint, eyes clearly visible). Removing them is safest.
glassesNo: Remove them (exceptions are rare, such as medical reasons).
checked: Checked against {source} in {date}. Rules change, so check that page before you apply. The exact wording behind each value is in the {evidence}.
tipsHeading: Tips for a photo that passes
tipLight: Stand about 60 cm (2 ft) in front of a plain, light wall, facing a window or soft light.
tipHelper: Have someone else take it with the back camera from about 1.2 m (4 ft) away. Arm's-length selfies can distort your face.
tipFace: Keep a neutral face with your mouth closed and both eyes open, looking straight at the lens.
tipRemoveGlasses: Remove hats, headphones, glasses and anything covering your face.
tipRemoveNoGlasses: Remove hats, headphones and anything covering your face.
tipSave: Use the saved JPEG for online applications, or print the 4×6 in (10×15 cm) sheet at 100% scale and cut along the lines.
disclaimerShort: This free tool is provided as is, with no warranty. It can make mistakes, so check your photo against the official rules before you submit it. Read the full {link}.
